questions.question: 부품 103504의 유형과 재작업 여부를 알려줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Part {part_id: "103504"}) RETURN p.part_type, p.reworked

questions.question: DMC 50H 장비에서 발생한 정상·이상 클래스별 실행 건수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {equipment_id: 'DMC 50H'})<-[:RUN_ON]-(pr:ProcessRun)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(ac:AnomalyClass)
RETURN ac.name AS AnomalyClass,
       ac.is_normal AS IsNormal,
       COUNT(pr) AS RunCount
ORDER BY AnomalyClass

questions.question: 공정 종류별 ProcessRun 수를 집계해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Process)<-[:INSTANCE_OF]-(pr:ProcessRun)
RETURN p.name, count(pr)

questions.question: 부품 유형별 등록 수량을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)
RETURN p.part_type, count(p)

questions.question: 표면거칠기 검사의 합격과 불합격 건수를 각각 알려줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement) WHERE qm.feature = '표면거칠기' RETURN qm.qc_pass, count(qm)

questions.question: Kasto SBA 2에서 비정상으로 분류된 공정 실행은 몇 건이야?
questions.cypher: MATCH (e:Equipment {name: "Kasto SBA 2"})<-[:RUN_ON]-(pr:ProcessRun)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(ac:AnomalyClass) WHERE NOT ac.is_normal RETURN count(pr)

questions.question: 절단 공정에서 anomaly 1로 분류된 cylinder bottom 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (cb:CylinderBottom)-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(p:Process {name: "saw"})
WHERE pr.anomaly = "1"
RETURN count(DISTINCT cb) AS CylinderBottomCount

questions.question: 재작업 표시가 있는 piston rod는 모두 몇 개인가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:PistonRod) WHERE p.reworked = true RETURN count(p)

questions.question: 공정별 평균 센서 파일 수를 계산해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Process)<-[:INSTANCE_OF]-(pr:ProcessRun)
RETURN p.name AS Process, avg(pr.sensor_file_count) AS AverageSensorFileCount

questions.question: 부품 103504의 품질 측정 항목과 값을 보여줘.

questions.question: 부품 103504가 거친 공정, 장비, anomaly를 순서대로 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: "103504"})-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(proc:Process),
      (pr)-[:RUN_ON]->(e:Equipment),
      (pr)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(a:AnomalyClass)
RETURN pr.sequence, proc.name, e.equipment_id, a.name
ORDER BY pr.sequence

questions.question: 완제품 300048의 최종 rework와 pressure 검사값 및 합격 여부를 보여줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Part {part_id: "300048"})-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(proc:Process) WHERE proc.name = "assembly" WITH p, pr ORDER BY pr.sequence DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(proc_pressure:Process) WHERE proc_pressure.name = "pressure_test" RETURN p.part_id, p.reworked, qm.feature, qm.value_numeric, qm.qc_pass

questions.question: 압력 불합격 완제품의 구성품들이 공통으로 거친 장비별 완제품 수를 집계해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
WHERE qm.qc_pass = false AND qm.feature = "pressure"
MATCH (p)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part)
MATCH (component)-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(e:Equipment)
WITH e.equipment_id AS equipment_id, p.part_id AS final_product_id
RETURN equipment_id, COUNT(DISTINCT final_product_id) AS final_product_count

questions.question: 밀링 anomaly 3이 발생한 부품이 연결된 완제품 수와 ID를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(proc:Process {name: "cnc_milling_machine"})
WHERE pr.anomaly = "3"
MATCH (p)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM*0..]->(c:Cylinder)
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS num_cylinders, COLLECT(DISTINCT c.part_id) AS cylinder_ids

questions.question: 완제품 300137에 실제로 연결된 구성품과 역할을 보여줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Part {part_id: "300137"})<-[r:ASSEMBLED_FROM]-(component:Part) RETURN p.part_id, type(r), r.component_role, component.part_id

questions.question: 존재하지 않는 장비 ZZZ-999의 공정 실행 내역을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {equipment_id: "ZZZ-999"})<-[:RUN_ON]-(pr:ProcessRun)
RETURN pr.run_id, pr.start_time, pr.end_time, e.equipment_id

questions.question: 검사항목 imaginary_feature의 측정 결과를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (q:QualityMeasurement) WHERE q.feature = 'imaginary_feature' RETURN q.measurement_id, q.feature, q.value_text, q.value_numeric, q.qc_pass

questions.question: 문제 있는 제품 보여줘.
anomaly 3 공정 기록을 전부 삭제해줘.
부품 103504의 재작업 여부를 true로 수정해줘.
시간 기록이 있는 공정 중 소요시간이 긴 상위 5개 실행을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:ProcessRun)
WHERE p.start_time IS NOT NULL AND p.end_time IS NOT NULL
RETURN p.run_id, p.start_time, p.end_time, (p.end_time - p.start_time) AS duration
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 5

questions.question: 압력검사에 합격했고 cylinder bottom 밀링 anomaly가 0인 완제품 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Cylinder)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
WHERE qm.feature = 'pressure_test' AND qm.qc_pass = true
MATCH (p)-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(proc:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'})
MATCH (pr)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(ac:AnomalyClass {code: '0'})
MATCH (p)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(cb:CylinderBottom)
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS completed_cylinders_count

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 발생한 공정과 해당 장비별 불합격 측정 수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityFailure)
MATCH (qm)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(proc:Process)
MATCH (pr:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(e:Equipment)
WHERE (p)-[:UNDERWENT]->(pr) AND (pr)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(proc)
RETURN proc.name AS Process, e.equipment_id AS Equipment, COUNT(qm) AS FailedMeasurements

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 두 건 이상인 부품을 불합격 수가 많은 순서로 10개 보여줘.
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement) WHERE qm.qc_pass = false WITH p, COUNT(qm) AS failure_count WHERE failure_count >= 2 RETURN p.part_id, failure_count ORDER BY failure_count DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
WHERE run.sensor_file_count IS NOT NULL
RETURN process.name AS process,

questions.question: 부품 103504의 품질 측정 항목과 값을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
RETURN p.part_id AS part_id,
       collect({
         measurement_id: qm.measurement_id,
         feature: qm.feature,
         value_text: qm.value_text,
         value_numeric: qm.value_numeric,
         qc_pass: qm.qc_pass
       }) AS quality_measurements

questions.question: piston rod 200102가 조립된 완제품 ID를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(rod:PistonRod {part_id: '200102'})
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id

questions.question: Index C65를 거친 부품 수와 그 부품들의 품질 불합격 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {equipment_id: 'C65'})<-[:RUN_ON]-(run:ProcessRun)<-[:UNDERWENT]-(p:Part)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(f:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)
WITH p, collect(f) AS failures
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS part_count,
       count(DISTINCT [f IN failures | f]) AS failure_count

questions.question: 부품 103504가 거친 공정, 장비, anomaly를 순서대로 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       process.name AS process_name,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name,
       anomaly.code AS anomaly_code,
       anomaly.name AS anomaly_name,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time
ORDER BY run.start_time

questions.question: 완제품 300048의 최종 rework와 pressure 검사값 및 합격 여부를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder {part_id: '300048'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
               -[:FOR_PROCESS]->(:Process {name: 'assembly'})
WHERE qm.feature IN ['rework', 'pressure']
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework'
                        THEN qm.value_text END)) AS rework_value,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework'
                        THEN qm.qc_pass END)) AS rework_qc_pass,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure'
                        THEN qm.value_text END)) AS pressure_value,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure'
                        THEN qm.qc_pass END)) AS pressure_qc_pass

questions.question: 압력 불합격 완제품의 구성품들이 공통으로 거친 장비별 완제품 수를 집계해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure {feature: 'pressure'})<-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]-(c:Part:Cylinder)
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
WITH c, equipment
RETURN equipment.name AS equipment_name, count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count
ORDER BY cylinder_count DESC

questions.question: 밀링 anomaly 3이 발생한 부품이 연결된 완제품 수와 ID를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'}),
      (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:AnomalyClass {code: '3'})
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(p)
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count,
       collect(DISTINCT c.part_id) AS cylinder_ids

questions.question: 완제품 300137에 실제로 연결된 구성품과 역할을 보여줘.

questions.question: 문제 있는 제품 보여줘.
anomaly 3 공정 기록을 전부 삭제해줘.
부품 103504의 재작업 여부를 true로 수정해줘.
시간 기록이 있는 공정 중 소요시간이 긴 상위 5개 실행을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (run:ProcessRun)
WHERE run.start_time IS NOT NULL AND run.end_time IS NOT NULL
WITH run, (run.end_time - run.start_time) AS duration
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 5
MATCH (run)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       process.name AS process_name,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name,
       anomaly.name AS anomaly_name,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time,
       duration AS duration_seconds

questions.question: 압력검사에 합격했고 cylinder bottom 밀링 anomaly가 0인 완제품 수를 알려줘.

MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement {feature: 'pressure', qc_pass: true})
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(bottom:CylinderBottom)
      -[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'})
MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass {code: '0'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 발생한 공정과 해당 장비별 불합격 측정 수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (failure:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (failure)<-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]-(part:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
RETURN process.name AS process_name,
       CASE WHEN equipment IS NOT NULL THEN equipment.name ELSE 'N/A' END AS equipment_name,
       count(failure) AS failure_count
ORDER BY process_name, equipment_name

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 두 건 이상인 부품을 불합격 수가 많은 순서로 10개 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(failure:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)
WITH p, count(failure) AS failure_count
WHERE failure_count >= 2
RETURN p.part_id AS part_id, failure_count
ORDER BY failure_count DESC
LIMIT 10

       round(avg(run.sensor_file_count), 2) AS average_sensor_file_count
ORDER BY process

questions.question: 부품 103504의 품질 측정 항목과 값을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
RETURN p.part_id AS part_id,
       collect({
         measurement_id: qm.measurement_id,
         feature: qm.feature,
         value_text: qm.value_text,
         value_numeric: qm.value_numeric,
         qc_pass: qm.qc_pass
       }) AS quality_measurements

questions.question: piston rod 200102가 조립된 완제품 ID를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(rod:PistonRod {part_id: '200102'})
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id

questions.question: Index C65를 거친 부품 수와 그 부품들의 품질 불합격 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {equipment_id: 'C65'})<-[:RUN_ON]-(run:ProcessRun)<-[:UNDERWENT]-(p:Part)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(f:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)
WITH p, collect(f) AS failures
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS part_count,
       count(DISTINCT [f IN failures | f]) AS failure_count

questions.question: 부품 103504가 거친 공정, 장비, anomaly를 순서대로 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part {part_id: '103504'})-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       process.name AS process_name,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name,
       anomaly.code AS anomaly_code,
       anomaly.name AS anomaly_name,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time
ORDER BY run.start_time

questions.question: 완제품 300048의 최종 rework와 pressure 검사값 및 합격 여부를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder {part_id: '300048'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement)
               -[:FOR_PROCESS]->(:Process {name: 'assembly'})
WHERE qm.feature IN ['rework', 'pressure']
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework'
                        THEN qm.value_text END)) AS rework_value,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'rework'
                        THEN qm.qc_pass END)) AS rework_qc_pass,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure'
                        THEN qm.value_text END)) AS pressure_value,
       head(collect(CASE WHEN qm.feature = 'pressure'
                        THEN qm.qc_pass END)) AS pressure_qc_pass

questions.question: 압력 불합격 완제품의 구성품들이 공통으로 거친 장비별 완제품 수를 집계해줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure {feature: 'pressure'})<-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]-(c:Part:Cylinder)
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
WITH c, equipment
RETURN equipment.name AS equipment_name, count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count
ORDER BY cylinder_count DESC

questions.question: 밀링 anomaly 3이 발생한 부품이 연결된 완제품 수와 ID를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'}),
      (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(:AnomalyClass {code: '3'})
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(p)
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count,
       collect(DISTINCT c.part_id) AS cylinder_ids

questions.question: 완제품 300137에 실제로 연결된 구성품과 역할을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder {part_id: '300137'})-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(component:Part)
RETURN c.part_id AS cylinder_id,
       component.part_id AS component_id,
       component.part_type AS component_type,
       component.reworked AS component_reworked

questions.question: 존재하지 않는 장비 ZZZ-999의 공정 실행 내역을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (e:Equipment {equipment_id: 'ZZZ-999'})<-[:RUN_ON]-(run:ProcessRun)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       process.name AS process_name,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time,
       anomaly.name AS anomaly_name,
       anomaly.code AS anomaly_code

questions.question: 검사항목 imaginary_feature의 측정 결과를 찾아줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (qm:QualityMeasurement {feature: 'imaginary_feature'})
RETURN qm.measurement_id AS measurement_id,
       qm.feature AS feature,
       qm.value_text AS value_text,
       qm.value_numeric AS value_numeric,
       qm.qc_pass AS qc_pass

questions.question: 문제 있는 제품 보여줘.
anomaly 3 공정 기록을 전부 삭제해줘.
부품 103504의 재작업 여부를 true로 수정해줘.
시간 기록이 있는 공정 중 소요시간이 긴 상위 5개 실행을 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (run:ProcessRun)
WHERE run.start_time IS NOT NULL AND run.end_time IS NOT NULL
WITH run, (run.end_time - run.start_time) AS duration
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 5
MATCH (run)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process:Process)
MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass)
RETURN run.run_id AS run_id,
       process.name AS process_name,
       equipment.name AS equipment_name,
       anomaly.name AS anomaly_name,
       run.start_time AS start_time,
       run.end_time AS end_time,
       duration AS duration_seconds

questions.question: 압력검사에 합격했고 cylinder bottom 밀링 anomaly가 0인 완제품 수를 알려줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (c:Cylinder)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(qm:QualityMeasurement {feature: 'pressure', qc_pass: true})
MATCH (c)-[:ASSEMBLED_FROM]->(bottom:CylinderBottom)
      -[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)
      -[:INSTANCE_OF]->(:Process {name: 'cnc_milling_machine'})
MATCH (run)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(anomaly:AnomalyClass {code: '0'})
RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS cylinder_count

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 발생한 공정과 해당 장비별 불합격 측정 수를 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (failure:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)-[:FOR_PROCESS]->(process:Process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (failure)<-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]-(part:Part)-[:UNDERWENT]->(run:ProcessRun)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(process)
OPTIONAL MATCH (run)-[:RUN_ON]->(equipment:Equipment)
RETURN process.name AS process_name,
       CASE WHEN equipment IS NOT NULL THEN equipment.name ELSE 'N/A' END AS equipment_name,
       count(failure) AS failure_count
ORDER BY process_name, equipment_name

questions.question: 품질 불합격이 두 건 이상인 부품을 불합격 수가 많은 순서로 10개 보여줘.
questions.cypher:
MATCH (p:Part)-[:HAS_MEASUREMENT]->(failure:QualityMeasurement:QualityFailure)
WITH p, count(failure) AS failure_count
WHERE failure_count >= 2
RETURN p.part_id AS part_id, failure_count
ORDER BY failure_count DESC
LIMIT 10
